summary.text: Raychel Proudie is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House District 73, which she has represented since 2019, and is the Democratic candidate for Missouri Senate District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Raychel Proudie is not running for re-election to House District 73 in 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the Budget Committee, the Children and Families Committee, the Joint Committee on Government Accountability and the Joint Committee on Public Assistance.
